cues: Suffixes decide the part of speech.
Ment, ion, ity, ness, ance and ship make nouns.
Er, or, ist and ian make a person.
Ise, fy and en make verbs.
Ful, less, ous, al, ive and able make adjectives.
text: Suffixes decide the part of speech. Ment, ion, ity, ness, ance and ship make nouns. Er, or, ist and ian make a person. Ise, fy and en make verbs. Ful, less, ous, al, ive and able make adjectives. And ly makes an adverb.
